modules.name: Standard Engine
modules.description: Factory-fitted drive. The hull's own speed and handling.

modules.name: Standard Weapon
modules.description: Factory-fitted battery. The hull's own weapon type, attack and fire rate.

modules.name: Standard Defense
modules.description: Factory-fitted protection. The hull's own shield, armour and defense profile.

modules.name: Ion Engine
modules.description: Efficient all-round drive: faster on the star map and in battle, but it turns in wide arcs.

modules.name: Fusion Engine
modules.description: Vectored-thrust drive built for combat: tight turns and a little extra battle speed.

modules.name: Warp Drive
modules.description: Long-range drive: much faster between stars, slightly sluggish in battle.

modules.name: Missile Launcher
modules.description: Missile salvos with extra reach. Fires more slowly.

modules.name: Laser Cannon
modules.description: Rapid-fire energy weapon. More shots per second.

modules.name: Railgun
modules.description: Heavy kinetic accelerator: the biggest punch, but its mass slows the ship in battle.

modules.name: Energy Shield
modules.description: Shield tuned against energy weapons. Vulnerable to kinetic rounds.

modules.name: Point-Defense Array
modules.description: Flak turrets and light plating that break up incoming missiles. Vulnerable to energy weapons.

modules.name: Kinetic Barrier
modules.description: Layered armour against kinetic rounds. Vulnerable to missiles, and its mass slows the ship in battle.

modules.name: Advanced Shield Generator
modules.description: High-capacity shield with fast regeneration. Keeps the hull's own defense profile.
